descriptions.w3d_d28e_open_node_801d3dd4: Start a node with a child: runs the match at 0x801d3930, then in sequence mode a partial match advances the index, pushes the node and dispatches the child through the handler table of the sub-object at +4, undoing both; outside sequence mode it dispatches the child and returns its error. Always ends through 0x801d3be0.
